description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Fault, which represents and manages XML-RPC fault responses including error codes, messages, XML parsing, and serialization.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Fault
classes.description: Container for XMLRPC faults, including fault codes, messages, and methods for XML serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Zend_XmlRpc_Fault with a code and message, defaulting to internal error messages if none are provided.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the encoding used in the fault response and updates the associated Zend_XmlRpc_Value encoding.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string to load fault information, validating structure and extracting code and message.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Static method to determine if a given XML string represents an XML-RPC fault.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the fault object to an XML string for response.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML string representation of the fault (calls saveXml).
